p.bio: Simonas Jeršovas ir the youngest team member in SSL Team Lithuania. He joined the team right before the SSL Gold Cup Finals. The athlete started his sailing career when he was 7 years old with „Optimist“ and was successfully gaining victories in national competitions and regattas. Later he sailed with „RS Feva“ „RS Aero“ and one of the most popular one design in Lithuania „RS 280“. S. Jeršovas is a universal team member and can be effective in any position.
